 Luka Doncic reaches Lakers legend on exclusive NBA all-time list 
 2026-10-27 19:10 
 Luka Doncic scored 52 points in his last game, giving him 10 career regular-season games with at least 50 points – tied with Kareem Abdul-Jabbar for 11th in NBA history.

 Los Angeles Lakers superstar Luka Doncic has started the season as one of the frontrunners to win his first career MVP award.

 The Lakers are perfect so far with a 3-0 record, while Doncic continues to make history.
 Doncic erupted for another incredible night, dropping 52 points on sizzling 17-of-30 shooting along with 10 assists, 8 rebounds, and 2 steals in 38 minutes to lead the Lakers to a 132-123 victory over the Utah Jazz.
 Doncic proved unstoppable, delivering the NBA's first 50-point performance of the season as his scoring outburst helped the Lakers overcome an 18-point Jazz lead to secure Sunday's win.
 With his 52 points in this game, he also made history by tying Lakers legend Kareem Abdul-Jabbar for 11th in NBA history for the most regular season games with at least 50 points.
 This was his 10th career 50-point regular season game. Wilt Chamberlain leads the all-time list with an incredible 118 50-point games.
 Michael Jordan is second with 31 games, while Kobe Bryant and James Harden are tied for third with 25.
 Luka Doncic surpasses LeBron James for most 40-point games in Lakers history
 By eclipsing the 40-point mark for the Los Angeles Lakers against the Utah Jazz, Luka Doncic surpassed LeBron James in a key milestone in the franchise's history.
 Doncic passed his former co-superstar to move into sixth on the all-time list for most 40-point games in franchise history.
 What is even more remarkable is that it only took 95 games for him to reach the franchise's 3,000-point mark.
 George Mikan, who trails Doncic on the all-time list, needed 106 games to reach the 3K club, while James required 114 games.
